description:
Changes feed

The feed of changes across all monitors of the workspace. Poll forward with `after` (the cursor from the previous call, oldest first) to pick up what is new; without it the newest come first. Each item is one resource of one check with its diff, unified patch and, when the monitor has a goal, the AI judge's verdict. `matters=true` keeps only changes the judge found relevant.

after.description: Return changes with an id above this one, oldest first; pass `nextCursor` back to keep polling.

before.description: Page back from this id, newest first.

matters.description: Only changes the AI judge marked as mattering for the monitor's goal.
